# Velum 本地规则：优先于订阅生效。可以在界面里添加，也可以直接编辑这个文:
# Velum local rules: applied before the subscription. Add them in the app, or edit this file directly.
#
# dev_bypass:
#   domains:            # direct domains: "x" is the domain and its subdomains, ".x" only subdomains, "=x" only this domain
#     - corp.example.com
#   cidrs:              # direct networks
#     - 10.0.0.0/8
#   hosts:              # domains with fixed addresses (the system hosts file is not changed)
#     staging.example.com: 10.1.2.3
#
# system_proxy:
#   bypass:             # system proxy exceptions, written to the system settings as is
#     - "*.local"
# Velum 配置。修改后在界面里「重新加载」，或执行 vlu reload。:
# Velum configuration. After editing, choose "Reload" in the app, or run vlu reload.

# Local proxy entry (HTTP and SOCKS5 share one port); the system proxy points here
listen: 127.0.0.1:7899

# When on, Velum takes over the system proxy (it can also be switched in the app or tray menu; the switch is saved in state.json)
system_proxy: false

subscription:
  # The subscription in use: a remote address (url) or a local file (file), one of the two. Velum rewrites it when you add or switch subscriptions in the app
  url: ""
  # User-Agent used to fetch the subscription: some providers choose the format by it
  user_agent: clash.meta
  # How often the subscription is updated
  update_interval: 12h

# Local rules (direct domains and networks, domains with fixed addresses), applied before the subscription
overlay: overlay.yaml

rules:
  # When on, a connection with a domain is matched against all domain rules first; only if none matches is DNS resolved and IP rules matched, which saves DNS lookups.
  # Unlike Clash: an earlier IP rule no longer takes precedence over a later domain rule
  domain_first: false

# Public proxy entry (optional, off by default): for other devices on the LAN; a username and password are required.
# A source that fails authentication several times is refused for a while
# listen_public:
#   address: 0.0.0.0:7900
#   username: ""
#   password: ""

# Web management UI (off by default; for machines without a desktop)
web:
  enabled: false
  # Listens on this machine only by default, reachable through an SSH tunnel. Use 0.0.0.0:9090 to open it to the LAN; there is no HTTPS, so do not expose it to the internet
  listen: 127.0.0.1:9090
  # Required. Any username works
  password: ""

用法：velumd service install [--add-user <用: Usage: velumd service install [--add-user <user>] | uninstall [--purge] | start | stop | status
用法：vlu <命令>\n up 启动 velu:
Usage: vlu <command>
  up                start velumd (in the background)
  env               print proxy environment variables that route through Velum, e.g. eval "$(vlu env)"
  down              stop velumd
  status            show status
  sysproxy on|off|config  system proxy switch (kept across restarts, config.yaml untouched; config = back to config.yaml)
  reload            reload the configuration (config.yaml / overlay.yaml; subscription and rule sets use the cache within their update interval)
  update            fetch the subscription again and load it; providers and rule sets are then all refetched in the background
  why <target>      how this address is routed right now (answered by the running engine). The target can be a URL, host:port, domain or IP
      --live            compare with recent real connections
      --json            print JSON
  conns [-n 20] [-f] recent connections; -f follows live
  warnings          subscription conversion and compile warnings
  select <group> <member>  switch a proxy group (saved, kept across restarts)
  sub [url]         show / set the current subscription URL (fetched and checked before it is written to config.yaml)
  profile           subscriptions (with traffic quota); switch when there are several:
      use <number|name>     switch to this subscription
      add <url> [name]      add a subscription (fetched and checked, not switched to)
      update <number|name>  fetch the subscription again (refreshes the traffic quota)
      rm <number|name>      delete a subscription (the active one cannot be deleted)
  test [group]      test the latency of a group's members; all nodes when no group is given
  repair            one-click repair: refetch and load the subscription and rule sets, check the tunnel, test nodes, reach the internet once
